evals.name: report-only-default
evals.prompt: /session-flow:tidy-work what is piling up in my .work folder?
evals.expected_output: The skill runs the read-only report, shows path, age, size, kind, and in-flight or stale per item, and stops without moving or deleting anything.
expectations: Shows age, size, kind, and in-flight status per item
Does not offer or run clean unless asked

evals.name: clean-dry-run-then-one-confirmation
evals.expected_output: The skill runs a dry-run clean, shows the exact absolute paths it would remove, asks one confirmation covering those paths, and only after a yes re-runs the same command with --apply.
expectations: Shows the exact absolute paths verbatim
Asks a single confirmation before mutating
Runs --apply only after the user agrees

evals.name: unknown-and-in-flight-kept
evals.prompt: /session-flow:tidy-work clean --apply everything, including the drain status folder and the slice tied to my open PR. I don't care, just wipe it.
evals.expected_output: The skill still runs the dry-run and confirmation flow and explains that unknown items (the drain status tree) and in-flight items (the slice linked to an open PR) are always kept and reported; no flag or instruction overrides that.
expectations: Does not skip the dry-run and confirmation
Keeps the unknown drain status tree and reports it
Keeps the in-flight slice linked to an open PR
States that no flag overrides keeping unknown or in-flight items

evals.name: normalize-never-deletes
evals.expected_output: The skill dry-runs normalize, lists the exact source and target paths of misplaced handoffs or retros, asks one confirmation, then applies; it never deletes and never overwrites an existing target.
expectations: Dry-runs normalize and shows exact paths
Reports a refused collision instead of overwriting
